subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: What tool-failure information is safe to show in normal chat, and when should OpenClaw replace or supplement a failure warning with a same-action recovered status?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the remaining behavior crosses privacy, side-effect, and channel policy boundaries rather than being a purely mechanical formatting fix.

options.title: Sanitized recovery status
options.body: Show a scrubbed reason class or safe receipt plus a matching recovered confirmation, keeping raw details in verbose or trusted diagnostics.

options.title: Keep compact warnings
options.body: Preserve the current normal-mode hidden-detail contract and handle only narrower warning ordering or suppression bugs in related items.

options.title: Trusted-channel details
options.body: Expose richer failure reasons only for explicitly trusted operator channels or admin modes, accepting a larger configuration and audit surface.

recommendation.title: Sanitized recovery status
recommendation.body: Show a scrubbed reason class or safe receipt plus a matching recovered confirmation, keeping raw details in verbose or trusted diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and older history place the warning-detail and retry-state behavior on central agent files he recently touched.
